rows.text: Did you talk to Dan Heng? How'd it go?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Full of enthusiasm.
He doesn't seem very enthusiastic...
Really? I find that hard to believe...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: *sigh* That's our Dan Heng — always trying to look cool with his poker face. Don't mind him~
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Relax, [Trailblazer]! Dan Heng and I are experienced trailblazers! We got your back!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, are you ready?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You bet!
I need a minute...
Are you doing okay after your first jump?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dizziness or retching are normal reactions. You'll feel better once you get used to it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I feel fine.
Why aren't you with everyone else?
So you have high compatibility with the Express. That's good.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I enjoy being alone, especially when I have important work to do.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I went through the Express' database, and it seems the environment on Jarilo-VI has undergone drastic changes in the past few centuries. It was not a frozen planet to begin with...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Welt says it was caused by a Stellaron.
He said so? Hmm... considering the spatial obstacles that the star rail has encountered, it's highly possible.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I've conducted a preliminary survey and found that there's one area with a relatively normal temperature on the surface of the planet. By "normal," I mean a temperature that just about allows for human survival.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If I had to choose a site for initial investigation on this trailblazing expedition, that would be it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Himeko wants you, me, and March 7th to go together.
Can't you and March 7th go?
...As I expected. Before you came, whenever March wanted to go anywhere, Himeko would make Mr. Yang and me go with her.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: And even after you arrived, I didn't suppose I'd be the one to be liberated of that duty.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If I know Himeko, she's not gonna let you stay behind.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You're new, I'm sure she wants to get you started with some firsthand trailblazing.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Don't worry. With March around, you are guaranteed an eventful expedition.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I assume the trailblazing objective this time is to find the Stellaron on Jarilo-VI and dispel the effect it's exerting on the star rail... right?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I see. [Trailblazer], you should find March. I'll join you two once I'm ready.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A planet covered in snow and ice... Will I find my answer here...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: WHOA! Don't sneak up on me like that!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Why are you still here? Go find Dan Heng! Exciting adventures are waiting for us.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ever since the Destruction sowed Stellarons across the universe, many worlds have changed.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Nanook the Destruction, Yaoshi the Abundance, Terminus the Finality... I've seen and learned a lot in my time, but I still struggle to understand some of the Aeons' actions.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thanks to a brilliant performance, you guys saved the space station from a moment of crisis. Now the Express is relying on you to get it moving again.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Remember, there are four things we do when we arrive at a new world: Explore, understand, establish, and connect.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: And I'm sure you'll get along really well with March and Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If we try to force our way ahead, there could be a hefty price to pay!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The only thing we can say for sure is that their arrival causes massive changes to civilizations and ecosystems. They also generate distortions in space such as Fragmentums.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I'd like to entrust this trailblazing expedition to March, Dan Heng, and you.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So it's still not our turn...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Alright! Here comes, the Jarilo-VI Trailblaze Team!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It really is one big snowball.
It doesn't feel that cold.
Why didn't we land at the destination?
I didn't know we'd be hiking...
Yeah, they're gonna regret it!
Let's just make sure that we're not the ones creating trouble...
After all those millennia... is this what Jarilo-VI has become?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Huh? So that snowy planet is our destination this time?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes... Looks like this trailblazing expedition won't be easy.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Spatial readout anomaly! Star rail stability is down to 12%!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Schedule alteration: Seven-day stopover time extended indefinitely!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: The complex locality of this world has been... affected somehow. The star rail has been blocked off by something.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Take an ordinary train as an example: It's like the tracks up ahead have suddenly snapped, and the way forward leads straight into a collapsing abyss...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The only sensible thing to do would be to brake hard, right?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Indefinitely. Until the anomaly is removed!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Take an ordinary train as an example: It's like the tracks up ahead have suddenly snapped, and the way forward leads straight into a collapsing abyss...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The only sensible thing to do would be to brake hard, right?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This again... Don't tell me, it's gotta be...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The results of the preliminary analysis are here — the anomaly stems from a Stellaron, as always.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yes, [Trailblazer] — just like the one that's been placed into your body.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Don't worry. It's not the first time our route has been obstructed by a Stellaron.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Stellarons are clouded in mystery — even Herta isn't able to fully understand them... but at least we know how to neutralize their influences.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Stellarons are clouded in mystery — even Herta isn't able to fully understand them...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: But there's no need to worry — this isn't the first time our route has been obstructed by a Stellaron. Even if we don't know much about them, at least we know how to neutralize their influences.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: There must be an inextricable connection between the Stellaron we're dealing with here, and Jarilo-VI becoming a frozen planet.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Our current theory is that Stellarons are seeds of disaster planted by a certain Aeon throughout the universe. We can't continue to trailblaze without removing the source of the disaster.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: That we've gotta get busy!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's empowering, looking out at a world from a window like this...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...but when you set foot on the planet itself, you realize how small and helpless you really are — just like them.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Right! You finally get what we're all about. Pretty cool, huh?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The objective is clear: Find the Stellaron responsible for the disaster and the spatial distortions, and bring it back to the Express. We'll deal with the rest.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Awesome! We get to work as a team again, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Someone has to stay on the train, or Pom-Pom will get lonely.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Not to mention, {RUBY_B#The Destruction}Nanook{RUBY_E#} threw us a glance just now. If we're targeted by the Antimatter Legion, then things could go south fast.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Because you three made a great team back in the space station. My guess is that if you spend even longer together, we'll see something even more impressive.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hey! That's not the spirit!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I know you really want to go, but we should give the youngsters a chance to get out there on their own. It'll be a good opportunity for them to bond.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: [Trailblazer], March, if you two are ready, why not go and find Dan Heng?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: He's probably already started collating the ecological data and survey results for Jarilo-VI. It's always good to know more about the destination before you start a journey.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: When I first saw this planet, I thought: A world covered in ice... could it have something to do with my past? Now I can't stop thinking about it.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Still, the ice that trapped me was Six-Phased Ice — a very rare substance. I don't think you can find it on your average planet...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: To be honest, I think I'd be kind of annoyed if I found out this was my homeworld. It looks freezing... Pretty girls aren't frost-resistant!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...What? Is there something on my face?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Nah~ I was just imagining all the fun we're gonna have here... hee-hee!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...I feel sorry for this world. First the Stellaron, and now you...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Jarilo-VI, we're here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Brrr. It really is one big snowball.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, get your own metaphor!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well the Trailblaze Path grants us faint power. It allows us to better adapt to harsh environments.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: *sigh* Snow as far as the eye can see. Which direction should we take?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Based on the coordinates, the target should be up ahead.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Then what are we waiting for? Let's go.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Do you want to mention the time we smashed a hole through Taikiyan Stadium, or shall I?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: *sigh* Please stop bringing that up. Let's just say that landings and crowds don't mix.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Unless you enjoy trailblazing through two weeks of community service.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I said drop it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Me neither, if only we had a snowmobile... We never get to bring anything cool from the Express.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Do you remember what you did to our last snowmobile?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Anyway, moving on.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Remember, we should stay vigilant. We know very little about this world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Calm down. Between the three of us, nothing will stand in our way.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I mean c'mon, [Trailblazer], you've got a Stellaron in your body, I have my special {RUBY_B#Mysterious Ice Crystal}Six-Phased Ice{RUBY_E#} powers, and Dan Heng... Uhh, he's got that mysterious past thing going for him...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So, if people start creating trouble for us, they're gonna regret it!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...So how long does "copycatitis" last?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, let's not get ahead of ourselves, hehe...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's go. Braving the unknown... that's the real spirit of trailblazing!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This place still hasn't been corroded, yet Fragmentum monsters have already made it here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I fear the Stellaron may be exerting a significant influence on this world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: *gasp* Did you see that? I think something's moving...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mm... It's just an ordinary snowdrift. Are you sure you're not seeing things?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Of course not, my eyesight's perfect! Come on, let's take a closer look.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: So why were you hiding from the Silvermane Guards?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uhh, I was just storing a few relics away from prying eyes, nothing serious. If it weren't for the uncompromising nature of our civil service, there'd be no need for secrecy.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: So whereabouts are you guys from, anyway? I don't mean to pry or anything, I just care about my friends! No pressure...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: This is Voidranger armor. It's ancient.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Voidranger? Was this planet invaded by the Antimatter Legion?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I don't know.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: These buildings have been buried in the snowfall.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Huh!? So these are rooftops? How long would snow have to fall to get this thick?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...A long, long time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (What a strange object... It seems really out of place in the Snow Plains.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Maybe Mr. Yang will know what this is. Let's send a message to ask him.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Hey, get outta there or you'll shiver to death.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Holding your breath won't help...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I got this, March.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If someone's got their head stuck in the sand, or the snow in this case...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...they just need a helping hand.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yeowch!
rows.speaker: Man Hiding in Snow

rows.text: My fine fellow, was that really necessary? Is crawling around in the snow a crime these days? I mean, c'mon, surely it doesn't warrant a spearing?
rows.speaker: Man Hiding in Snow

rows.text: ...But then again how can I blame you? I mean, I caught you off guard. It had to happen — you could even say I deserved it, huh? Besides, I've made a gallant group of new friends as a result, hehe...
rows.speaker: Man Hiding in Snow

rows.text: ...Is Captain Gepard around? H—He's an old buddy of mine...
rows.speaker: Man Hiding in Snow

rows.text: Who?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Wait, you're not Silvermane Guards? Well, why didn't you say so? Turns out we're on the same side after all!
rows.speaker: Man Hiding in Snow

rows.text: Pleasure to meet you, the name's Sampo Koski.
rows.speaker: Man Hiding in Snow

rows.text: Excellent, I'll remember the name. I never thought I'd run into friends from the same line of work out here in this frozen wasteland. *sigh* Business is bad these days, but fear not, Sampo Koski isn't interested in hoarding. There's more than enough treasure to go around, so let's get rich together! Hahaha.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Say, why don't we join forces? I have reliable intel the main strength of the Silvermane Guards is being deployed to the front line. This is a golden opportunity...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...Come now, friends. I can understand the mistrust, but there's no need for the charade.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Then again, I know the rules, vigilance is the name of the game in our profession. It's my fault for letting my enthusiasm and sincerity get the better of me...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Anyway, a meeting like this has to have been written in the stars. Ask me anything you like — I won't skimp on the details. Still, make it snappy, you're never more than ten feet from a Silvermane Guard...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Settlement? What a literary turn of phrase. Why, there's only one place in this world where the living still reside — our beloved Belobog! The further away you get, the dicier things become.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: The City of Preservation, the Towering Citadel, humanity's last bastion against the Eternal Freeze... It may sound a bit over the top, but those names are grounded in truth. The only place humans can eke out an existence is behind those impregnable walls.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Me? You guys scared me to death... There I was looking for relics to sell, when all of a sudden you came stomping over. I thought the Silvermane Guards were paying me a visit.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Seriously though, try treading a little lighter next time, hmm? If you run into the Guards, they won't hide in a snowdrift... and you'll be in a cell before you know it.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You...You really don't know? The Silvermane Guards are Belobog's soldiers, enforcers, and police. Let's just say they're not the most flexible of people... and they like paying visits to folks in our line of work.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Seems like you guys really are new to the business. *sigh* To be young and naive again... How about this. As a senior in the field, which I'm sure you don't mind me saying, I'll give you some free guidance.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: There are ways of doing things in this profession, and you better get familiar with them. Moving in the shadows, finding the goods, pricing your stock, hiding from the Guards... there's an art to all of it.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: No need, why don't you just take us to the city? We don't really know the way.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The city? Already? I haven't even started trading yet. Showing you the way is easy enough, missy, but it would cost—
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...B—But it would be my pleasure! "Kindness" is Sampo Koski's middle name. Follow me, friends, and keep quiet. We don't want to be spotted by the Guards.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...Rule number seven: Never leave a footprint. I have my own special technique called "invisible snow-walking." Helps me throw off pursuers in no...time...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...Who are they?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Uh, you remember the Silvermane Guards I mentioned? That's them...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Help me, old friends! I don't wanna be caught!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: It's the suspect and his accomplices! Arrest them!
rows.speaker: Soldier

rows.text: ...And the prime suspect? The one with the blue hair?
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Apologies, Captain! W—We lost him during the pursuit. We can't find his footprints...
rows.speaker: Soldier

rows.text: *sigh* No matter, we have his accomplices. He'll be close by, plotting his next move.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Yeah, we'd never team up with someone like him!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...As in, forever.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm not trying to talk our way out of this, but... we're not friends with that scoundrel. Did you see how fast he ditched us?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We rescued him from the snow out of the kindness of our hearts. We had no idea he might be using us to get past you! Are you really dumb enough to fall for his...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm a captain, not an adjudication panel. As a Belobog citizen, you have the right to defend yourself, but that can only take place under the scrutiny of the Architects, not now.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Take them away.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: But we're not from Belobog!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Silence! What kind of nonsense are you—
rows.speaker: Soldier

rows.text: As you were. We must not be tempted into careless judgment. Look at their attire. Indeed, it is not in the Belobog style.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Exactly! A—And we even have photos!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: As you were. We must not be tempted into careless judgment. Look at their relics. We've never excavated anything like them before, and I haven't seen anything similar in our museums.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Photos?
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Ah! [Trailblazer], you're a genius! Great idea!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You've probably never seen what your planet looks like, right? I took this one. Behold, Jarilo-VI...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March 7th shows Gepard a picture of the ice-covered planet...
...You mean to say that this... white ball... That's here? That's our home? How can that...
rows.speaker: Soldier

rows.text: It is said that a long time ago, {RUBY_B#Interstellar Travelers}strange visitors from beyond the sky{RUBY_E#} would visit us here... but that after the Eternal Freeze, the blizzards made passage impossible... and Belobog would cease to witness such arrivals.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: But these people are—
rows.speaker: Soldier

rows.text: This decision is beyond us. If what they say is true, then only the supreme guardian may decide their fate.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Our job is to present them before her. Nothing more.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Outsiders, follow me. Belobog lies beyond this blizzard.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: ...Hey, it feels like it got a bit warmer!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...That's because you're in Belobog, the last bastion of humanity.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: Last bastion?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Seven hundred years ago, {RUBY_B#Antimatter Legion}monsters{RUBY_E#} from beyond the sky set the world ablaze. The land was turned to scorched earth, with raging infernos and billowing towers of smoke stretching beyond the horizon.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: In the midst of the conflict, the Eternal Freeze descended without warning. Suddenly, sweeping winds brought blizzards which buried the invading Legion. Belobog was all that remained.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: The steadfast Architects built this city. Under the protection of Qlipoth {RUBY_B#Aeon}the Preservation{RUBY_E#}, Belobog remains forever warm in the face of unrelenting cold.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: (...He's sure saying some weird stuff.)
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: (A marked change in tone. It sounds like he's quoting from a historical record.)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (Uh-huh, so why is he telling us all this?)
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You wanted to know.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: We saw strange creatures outside the city... They must have come from a tear in corroded space. A Fragmentum, correct?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: How do you... That's right. Out there in the blizzard, there are still many threats... including the monsters you saw.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: The Silvermane Guards are continuously engaged with the enemy, but I'm afraid the situation is bleak... After your meeting with the supreme guardian, I would like to consult you on this matter. *sigh* We're lacking in intel.
rows.speaker: Gepard

rows.text: What happened? Seems serious...
Who are those guys behind the captain? Look at their attire, so strange...
Look, Captain Gepard's back!
So impressive... I want to become as strong a Silvermane Guard as him!
The heater you saw is just a standard Geomarrow radiator. They may not look like much, but they're a real lifeline to the people.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: The blizzards here are brutal. If we didn't have a reliable way of keeping warm, Belobog would long since have become a dead city — both above and below the surface.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: What is Geomarrow?
Above and beneath the surface?
Why is the heater outside?
Thanks for your answers.
It's an ore — a special energy resource. Whether it's keeping the city warm or keeping our counters ticking, everything runs on Geomarrow.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Geomarrow grows beneath the surface of the planet, and specialist Underworld mining teams are there to extract it. Transport lines shuttle it up to the surface. In the Overworld, we use the same lines to ship surface goods and aid down to the Underworld.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: You didn't know? Belobog is structured like two big connected discs. The Overworld is responsible for administration and trade, while the Underworld is responsible for energy supply and resource extraction.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: However, due to an order that was given many years ago, nobody has moved between the Overworld and the Underworld in a long time.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: ...Ah! I shouldn't be talking about this. Pretend I never said anything.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Isn't it just like cooking food over an open flame? If the house is a pot, then the heater is the stove it rests on.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: When she puts it like that, it actually starts to make sense...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No sweat. This is your first time in Belobog — I just want you to feel some of the warmth the city has to offer.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Hey, seeing as there's nothing on your plate just now, wanna help me fix up this machine? Just a bit of manual labor — you might find it interesting.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Sure, we're not busy.
Great! Then let me give you a demonstration first.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Nice! You guys are pretty handy — you picked that up in no time. Wanna be my assistants? Average pay, but I'm a good boss.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Sure, why not.
Allow me to refuse.
Hah — do you just say yes to everything?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hahaha, I was only kidding — just a joke.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Well, I'd better carry on here, why not have a better look around? My workshop will always be open to you... and your wallets, of course.
rows.speaker: Serval

rows.text: Ah, that's the alley that Gepard mentioned — the one contaminated by the Fragmentum, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I can't believe how close it is to the city center...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If they hadn't identified it, I bet all the shops and hotels in the vicinity would have had to close down by now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Move back! This is your final warning!
rows.speaker: Stern Silvermane Guard

rows.text: But... B—But my proof of property is inside. I don't have any—
rows.speaker: Distressed Citizen

rows.text: The Fragmentum has already corroded this block! You can make a property retrieval request to the Architects, but only Silvermane Guards are permitted to enter here!
rows.speaker: Stern Silvermane Guard

rows.text: I can't believe Fragmentum corrosion has spread into the city... No wonder there are so many soldiers stationed there.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This world really is in dire straits.
Can soldiers really hold back the Fragmentum?
It sure is... but at least we're here. Once we seal the Stellaron, they can get back to the good life.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: No. As long as the Stellaron is active, the corrosion will continue to spread.

rows.text: Y'know, the underground has been cut off from the surface for years. For you outsiders to descend on us out of nowhere is pretty incredible.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Everything alright? You feeling okay?
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: I want to ask about the Underworld...
I want to ask about Sampo...
I want to ask about Wildfire...
I'm fine.
The Underworld? What do you want to know?
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Why do people live down here?
How is life in the Underworld?
I want to ask something else.
Because we need Geomarrow. After Belobog's construction, the demand for energy kept increasing. The Eternal Freeze prevented us from expanding outwards, so our only choice was to go down.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: The people answered the call of the Architects and descended, excavating ore veins and establishing mines. Before we were sealed off, it was an honor to work underground.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: It was a choice... the pursuit of arduous labor for the survival of our entire civilization.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: ...It's never been good. Conditions are tough both above and below the surface. The Overworld is faced with the Eternal Freeze and Fragmentum corrosion, and the Underworld has to contend with hard labor, suffocating heat, and serious shortages.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: It's been over a decade since the Silvermane Guards withdrew from the Underworld, and the situation here has only gotten worse. The only contact we have is the exchange of Geomarrow for goods.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: And what's more... the Fragmentum corrosion has begun to reach us down here, too...
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Ask away, but I'm afraid I don't know a lot about him myself.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: How did you get to know him?
Do you know where he went?
I want to ask something else.
A meticulously choreographed "chance meeting..." Sampo is pretty good at orchestrating unexpected encounters, and he always leaves a lasting impression.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: According to him, that's the gift of a businessman.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Hehe, I hear that question a lot — seems like he owes everyone something. That's why he never discloses his whereabouts.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: When people need him, he appears, and when people really need him, he disappears. Sampo's first and second laws of motion.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: ...I'm a doctor, not an informant! Very well, what's the question?
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: What is Wildfire?
How can I find them?
Wildfire is a volunteer grassroots organization. Like I said, you can think of it as the Silvermane Guards of the underground.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: They've taken on the duties of the Guards: Maintain safety and order in the Underworld and compete with Fragmentum corrosion for living space.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Wherever there is hardship and a cry for help, there is Wildfire.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: ...You can always find them.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Okay, take care, and make sure you look after yourself.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: There are so many people here — Hook's too short. I can't see anything...
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: Wha—! When did you... D—Did you hear what Hook was saying?
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: Not a single word.
Not a single word about you saying you're too short.
Good. Hook didn't say anything, and you didn't hear it.
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: Hmph, grown-up fights are less fun than ours. So what if I can't see!
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: You have to use your fists, palms, and even your fingers in combat! If you don't know how, you're done for! You need to train until your body is an extension of the mind... and the mind is an extension of your will.
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: Fists, palms, and fingers... *gasp* Rock, paper, scissors! Phew! No wonder I was confused!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hehe, good. Wait a second... You did too hear everything Hook was saying!
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: Did you hear!? There's a new fighter at the club! He knocked the last champ's teeth out!
rows.speaker: Excitable Spectator

rows.text: Really? At least he still has his mouthguard...
rows.speaker: Calm Spectator

rows.text: ...Dark sense of humor you got there.
rows.speaker: Excitable Spectator

rows.text: I heard a new fighter showed up at the club — young guy, dark hair. They say he's invincible! Where did he come from?
rows.speaker: Curious Spectator

rows.text: I heard someone say he's an elite Silvermane Guard.
rows.speaker: Inquiring Spectator

rows.text: Don't be ridiculous. The Silvermane Guards have been gone for ages. Why would one suddenly appear out of the blue?
rows.speaker: Curious Spectator

rows.text: A club just for fighting... who knew undergrounders had such brutal hobbies.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Mm-hmm, in fact, it's awesome!
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: They let YOU take part!? When did this place last have an inspection!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Loads of kids take part.
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: ...Despicable. My "criminal activity" senses are tingling.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, where are you going?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Come back, come back, they won't be hiding that far away!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Moles haven't lost a game for ages! You're doomed!
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: You got it yet? We're the underground's greatest hiders and seekers!
rows.speaker: Hook

rows.text: Let's help her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well it's like this: The chief's in the market for specific talent — an urgent request. So, I'm taking them to see him...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: *sigh* ...Come on, those toys of yours aren't that dangerous.
Uh, then why hasn't {F#she}{M#he} woken up yet?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Because {F#she's}{M#he's} sound asleep — didn't you hear {F#her}{M#him} sleep talking? ...Poor child, sounded like a bad nightmare.
Tell me the truth Sampo — what are you gonna do about the Overworld girl?
What am I gonna do about her? Why, wait for the opportunity and send her back together with the rest of them of course, I... Hey come on, what's with the—
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You're a bad liar, Sampo Koski.
Wha— ...I didn't mean to bring her along! The smoke was too dense, I was in a daze! Before I knew it, I'd somehow dragged her down here too.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: What are you up to, Sampo? Why do you insist on getting caught up in Overworld affairs that have nothing to do with you? If it's a whole lot more attention from Wildfire you want, you're going about it the right way.
Hey now! Sampo Koski's primary concern is taking care of his friends. These guys scratched my back. How could I live with myself if I didn't scratch theirs?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: And another thing! Where does Wildfire get off... assuming that these fine folks won't come in useful to them, huh? I mean, you never know.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Which is why you've set them loose in the underground?
Come on, accidents happen! I'll have them rounded up in no time.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: *sigh* That girl... get her back as soon as possible, then don't let her out of your sight. The underground has been sealed off for over ten years now — the children won't even remember what overgrounders look like. If a girl in a Silvermane Guard uniform suddenly shows up...
...what would Wildfire do with her? What would they do with you?
Alright, I get it! I'm setting off right now. I'll have to trouble you to look after them while I'm gone, ma'am.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...Hey sleepyhead, looks like you're awake.

H—Hey! It's you! I was just thinking to myself: "Am I getting robbed? Who are these people following me?" So, y'know, you start to walk a little faster, and... Anyhoo if I'd just turned around, I could've thrown open my arms and said a big "hi" to my old friends.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Save it. You saw us in there and got scared, so you pulled a runner.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Me? Scared? Hahaha, my friends, what do I have to fear? *gasp* Surely I haven't done anything to offend you?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You threw us to the Silvermane Guards.
You set Dan Heng up.
Nah, we're just messing with you.

Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa rewind. If I hadn't made a break for it, Gepard would've caught all of us. And do you think he would've given you a chance to explain yourselves? Hmm? He would've checked you straight into the graybar hotel!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Meanwhile, there I was, looking out for you from the shadows! Do you know how difficult it was to make an entrance? They were watching you the whole time!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Set him up? Yeah, with a job! You guys are new here, and let me tell you — you're gonna need some cash.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: And, Sampo Koski stops at nothing to help his friends. Saving you was just the beginning — I have to consider your finances too! With me you get the full service, folks. That's friendship.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...My fine fellow, please don't do that again. You scared the daylights outta me.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Wait a minute, we're not done here! You dragged us to the underground — so what's the big idea?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I had no choice but to take you guys down here. It was too dangerous for us on the surface — we're wanted criminals!? Sure, the Underworld has its drawbacks, but at least the Guards would never follow us. We're safe here...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Be that as it may, did you really have to poison us?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Maybe you've forgotten, but we were in a tight spot my friend — there was no time to think. I had to use whatever I could.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Hmm.. So it wasn't to cover anything up? A secret that you didn't want anyone, including us, to find out?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng, what secret?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm not certain yet... but there's more to our "friend" here than meets the eye.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You win! I'll help you to the best of my ability — free of charge I might add! But please, don't go spreading rumors about me?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: *sigh* Alright! To prove my sincerity, I'll introduce you to Wildfire. If you're looking for something down here, they're the ones to ask!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Why should we get to know Wildfire?
Why would Wildfire want to help us?
What kind of organization is Wildfire?
Lead the way... and don't try and pull anything this time.

Because you are looking for something! Why are you asking? Dan Heng told me you guys were searching for a... what's the word... "Stellaron" — sounded pretty powerful. If anyone has a clue on its whereabouts, it'll be Wildfire.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You said I'd uncover a clue if I became the Fight Club champion.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Uhh... Uh, y—yeah! I mean, If you'd fought in the final round and won, you'd have incredible street cred right now! Wildfire wouldn't think twice about talking with you. I don't see the problem.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Well, there's no such thing as a free lunch, of course. Wildfire has no reason to help you yet, so we'll just have to give them one! With your talents, we have nothing to worry about.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: I'm telling you, no matter where you go, there's only one rule to getting things done: Find the demand. Y'know, like supply and demand? Anyway, The underground has been sealed off for more than a decade — but do you think people here are just resigned to their fate?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Well if you want my opinion, they're a bunch of artless, stubborn fools. But who cares what I think, huh?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: They're a band of do-gooders who sprung up to maintain order in the underground. After the Silvermane Guards withdrew, Wildfire set up shop.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Still, don't underestimate them! "We walk in the presence of giants" — have you heard that saying before? Well, Wildfire has giants in its midst. You'll see.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Have a little faith! It's like I said: "Sampo never lets friends who've helped him come to harm." Hehe...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...Brothers and sisters! Are you ready for today's most spectacular, spine-tingling, earth-shattering contest!?
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: On one side — recommended by Tall, Blue, and Handsome — the unsmiling pulverizing power of the new kid on the block: Cold Dragon Young!
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: And his opponent is... none other than the unfeeling, incendiary, explosive might of Team Robomatic! All praise to Boss Svarog!
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: Given that no other fighter was willing to take on the strength of Team Robomatic, Cold Dragon Young will face off against these opponents alone! On learning his fate, the brave young fighter had one thing to say: "Whatever!"
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: And so, let the semifinals of the 1758th Fighting King Challenge... begin!
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: [Trailblazer], quick! Let's help him!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh-ho? Brothers and sisters, an unexpected turn of events... Two members of the audience have charged into the octagon! It looks like they want to team up with Cold Dragon Young!
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: ...So you're awake?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Yeah! The first thing [Trailblazer] and I did was go look for you! And now that we've found you, we're trying to make sure you don't get your butt kicked! You're welcome~
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Brothers and sisters, you can feel their passion! The magnetic pull of this electric sport is undeniable! But let me reiterate: These competitions are for professionals only! Whatever you do kids, don't try this at home!
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: And Cold Dragon Young is signaling that the contest will go ahead! He's just itching to get into it! And so are we! It's the iron fists of Cold Dragon Young — and friends — versus the iron skin of Team Robomatic!
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: I can take them on my own, you know.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...*sigh* We need to work on your emotional intelligence.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hold the line!
Destroy them all!
I just want to go home!
Oh! What a beautiful performance! Cold Dragon Young and his last-minute admirers emerge victoriouuuus!
rows.speaker: Dr. Dig

rows.text: Admirers... How come we don't get cool nicknames!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Cold Dragon Younger and Cold Dragon Youngest?
Cooler than Cold Dragon Young...?
*sigh* Forget it. I think our taste in nicknames is different.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey! Look! It's Sampo!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We've got an explanation to demand.
We've got another butt to kick.
We should thank him.
Let's get after him.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hold the line!
Destroy them all!
I just want to go home!
Cold Dragon Younger and Cold Dragon Youngest?
Cooler than Cold Dragon Young...?
We've got an explanation to demand.
We've got another butt to kick.
We should thank him.
Seele's usually always out on patrol here at this time...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: What's Wildfire up to...? Hmm... are they avoiding me?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: So... what does Wildfire do all day?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Everything. They keep the peace, uphold justice, fight for resources, distribute goods...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: The sliver of trust they have for me has to do with the last one...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Huh? Where's Joshua?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: What're those shiny rocks?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah, this is Geomarrow, an exothermic ore. The underground and the surface are sealed off from one another, right? Well only the Geomarrow transport line is still running. The underground sends ore to the surface, and the surface sends goods to the underground. At least in theory.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Most undergrounders are miners, and this is what they mine for a living. Y'know, if we didn't have Geomarrow to burn, this world would have frozen to death long ago.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Hmm, let's keep moving. The person I was looking for isn't here...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Huh...? Old Oleg isn't here either. Where is everyone? Hehe, hm...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Gah, so you're leading us on another wild goose chase?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I wouldn't dare! Trust me, we're getting close!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: *sigh* Huh? What's that huge structure in the distance...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, that's the Furnace Core, and it's also the pillar that connects the Underworld and the Overworld. People used to travel up and down that thing, but then...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Then what?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's a long story. In any case, practically nothing moves up or down anymore.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Except you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Oh! C'mon, my dear fellow, I thought we weren't going to discuss this? I beg you, the fewer rumors there are about me, the better!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Hey, look! Who is that?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is that... Bronya?
She's here too?
It looks like she's in trouble...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: M—My friends, don't just stand there! This drama really doesn't need any more bystanders!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Oh? Y'know, it might be interesting to see you get in trouble.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We should avoid attracting too much attention... but we can't just leave her.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Sampo's right, we can't just stand here.
Dan Heng's right, we can't ignore this.
March is right. Does anyone have popcorn?
Yeah! Now you're getting it.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Exactly! My boy Cold Dragon Young — uh... young master Dan Heng speaks with reason.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Eh, I was kidding, and get your own opinion!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I agree with Dan Heng, we can't just leave her to the bullies.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well said! The young lady is wise and righteous!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Let's help her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Argh, darn it! Quick, disperse!
rows.speaker: Vagrant

rows.text: Spineless thugs!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Miss Seele! Phew, it's a good thing you showed up when you did. My heartfelt thanks~
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: These vagrants have got some nerve looking for trouble in Wildfire terri—
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Shut it Sampo, this has "you" written all over it. Wildfire has countless issues on its plate right now. We don't need a side order of Koski.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I hear a Silvermane Guard is paying the Underworld a visit... is that you?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You kidnapped me and brought me to the underground. What is the meaning of this?
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Hmph, listen to her. "What is the meaning of this?" ...She still thinks she's an Overworld princess.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Do you know what's become of us down here while you live the easy life? Did you even consider the fate of the Underworlders?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The Silvermane Guards aren't "living the easy life." We are constantly engaged with the enemy — defending Belobog from the scourge of attacking monsters... and protecting all those above and below the surface.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Hah, do you even hear yourself? You? Protect the underground? Redeploying every Guard to the surface, sealing off the only passageway... Protecting the so-called Architects, more like it.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The Madam Guardian has her reasons...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Hmph.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Enough talk, you're coming with me. Chief Oleg wants to see you, and he's got more than a few questions.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Perfect, Miss Seele! We were just on our way to pay Chief Oleg a visit ourselves. Room for a few more?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Fully booked.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: ...Who are they?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I'm [Trailblazer].
I'm a friend of Sampo's.
I'm Oleg's guest.
...What good is your name by itself!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: A friend of his? Then most of the underground is your enemy.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You know the chief? Then why don't I know you...
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Well it's like this: The chief's in the market for specific talent — an urgent request. So, I'm taking them to see him...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: We're looking for a Stellaron — it's the source of all the disasters here. If we find it, we can—
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ahaha — ahem! I would recommend you not recite your story to everyone you meet. Miss Seele won't understand it anyway, so let's save it for the chief, huh?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You're right, I don't understand it, and I don't plan on passing the message on either. Wildfire's encountered trouble at the Great Mine — the chief's busy. If you really want to find him, come look for me at the mine entrance.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I'm leaving.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Hey, you came. That was fast.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: What is Wildfire doing in the mine?
What trouble has Wildfire gotten into?
Didn't I tell you? *sigh* Long story short —
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The underground used to have many mines. However, in recent years, some sort of corrosion called the "Fragmentum" started to spread. It's ruined a lot of mines.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The one we're heading into is relatively unaffected. A bunch of vagrants made it their home after their old turf was consumed by the Fragmentum. Actually, most of them are pretty honest folks...
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: But with such a large group, it's inevitable that troublemakers will find their way in. They've been stealing from the miners and picking fights. And that's not the worst of it.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Things are much more serious this time... For two days now, huge clashes have been breaking out between the miners and the vagrants. It isn't pretty.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Mines are our lifelines in the Underworld. We have to keep providing Geomarrow to the Overworld in exchange for supplies.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: In order to quell the situation, Chief Oleg brought Wildfire into the mine and left me in charge of security for the towns. But the situation in the mine is critical — I have to back him up.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I don't think I understood, can you go over it again?
Understood, let's go.
Oh, as for you... the Chief will decide your fate when we see him.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Good, I've been wanting to come face to face with the leader of the Underworld.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Hmph, you're about to come face to face with reality.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Oh, hi [Trailblazer], wanna listen to my thoughts on the underground?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sure.
Not right now.
No worries, just thought you might be interested.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Where should I start?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I want to hear about your observations....
I want to hear what you think about the others...
That's it for now.
Ha, my observational skills are second to none.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How about the Underworld geography?
How about Underworld life?
How about the Underworlders?
That's all I can think of.
Well, the Underworld is surrounded by cliffs, and there's no obvious structure. It seems like a spread out collection of mines and small towns — just like the outskirts of Belobog.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There's that huge pillar called the Furnace Core that's always in view — maybe it's some kind of energy hub?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: From what I've seen, the residents are nearly all miners. It seems like the people here have less than those in the Overworld.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Still, the miners watch fights in their spare time. It's less pretentious than that theater they have on the surface.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: They're always in a hurry. The pace of life here is so fast! Things are pretty busy in the Overworld too, but everything feels more relaxed up there.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm not so good at analyzing people, but seeing as you asked...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Sampo?
Hook?
Bronya?
Seele?
That's all I can think of.
That guy!? He's lazy, lying, cunning, and evil! I don't like him — can't stand the sight of him.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I bet you think he's pretty entertaining. Watch out, or he'll fool you!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah, you mean that naughty kid we played hide-and-seek with?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Dr. Natasha said that she's a handful, but that she also takes care of the homeless kids. Maybe she's more mature than she seems?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Still, I can't believe how arrogant she is. I was pretty mad with her for a while.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Silvermane girl? She's pretty. I like looking at her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When I first met her I thought she was kinda scary, but now it seems like there's something on her mind. I'm too nervous to ask her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: At least she's not trying to arrest us anymore.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She says what she thinks — I like her. And did you hear what she said about the Silvermane Guards? Haha, sounded like she'd been waiting a long time to say it. I think I'd get along with her.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If we can get her to help us, we'll bag a Stellaron in no time!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If you hear any juicy gossi— uh... information, come find me!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Bored? Your big brother Sampo's always up for a chat.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Who the heck are you?
Who are Wildfire and Seele?
What do Wildfire want?
Good to chat.
What kind of question is that!? I'm your old pal — Sampo Koski — we've been through thick and thin together!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: You didn't answer the question.
We haven't been through thick OR thin... pal.
My old pal!
Well, that just means there's something wrong with your question! Questions are like transactions — if your request isn't clear, you might end up buying the wrong thing.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: What do you mean!? We battled wind and snow — fought shoulder to shoulder against the great Gepard Landau! I risked life and limb in the Fragmentum to save you from the evil clutches of the fearsome Bronya Rand!
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: How's that for thick and thin?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Yeah! Haha... Wait, do you mean it?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Wildfire are one of my major clients, though the work is mostly odds and ends... Still! It's always a pleasure. Haha, who am I to complain if the money's right, huh?
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Seele works for them — Oleg's most trusted lieutenant. *sigh* To her I'm probably just, uh, Wildfire's lapdog.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: Haha! But a very contented lapdog, I should add! Hehe...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: As a non-member, not a clue. They'd never tell me their ultimate aims. Shame, really, it's not like I'm a blabbermouth...
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: A pleasure! Until next time.
rows.speaker: Sampo

rows.text: ...I will arrest you under the supreme guardian's decree. Nothing has changed.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I am not your friend...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: It takes time to make friends.
I like to get close to my enemies.
Please arrest me! I can't wait!
...There's... something wrong with you.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...I saw you the day before the Goethe Hotel. Gepard took you to see mo— ...the supreme guardian. He told me you were visitors from beyond the sky.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Just like the interstellar travelers of ancient legend — people of all kinds that carried the will of the Aeons.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Gepard said that you wanted to help us reverse the damage that the Eternal Freeze and Fragmentum continue to wreak on our planet... but that night, mother summoned me, and ordered me to take a detachment to arrest you.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: What happened? The supreme guardian didn't tell me the details and Gepard had to rush back to the front line... I don't understand...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: You're not the only one...
We really do want to help you.
The supreme guardian betrayed us.
The Silvermane Guards withdrew to the surface long ago... I must avoid that identity here.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Until we're back in the Overworld, I propose a temporary truce and cooperation. Your true intentions are of interest to me...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: If it helps you to trust me, I'm willing to answer your questions to the best of my ability.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: What crime have we committed?
Do you know where the Stellaron is?
Why did the Silvermane Guards withdraw from the underground?
Why are you willing to cooperate with us?
That's all I have to ask.
Let me repeat — all I received were the supreme guardian's instructions. It is for the adjudication panel to pass judgment on the accused.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...All the supreme guardian told me was that your identities were counterfeit, and that your intention was to overthrow the rule of the Architects.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Truthfully, I've never heard of this Stellaron.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: But if all this catastrophe could be brought to an end simply by sealing it, then I hope its existence proves to be real.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Fragmentum monster activity on the surface intensified, and hostilities on the front line were critical. To resist the invasion, the Architects had no choice but to redeploy the Guards to the front line.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...If we couldn't hold our defensive line, then we wouldn't be able to maintain our supply of aid to the underground, which would have collapsed without us. That was the supreme guardian's explanation.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: In truth... I've always felt like something important is being hidden. Whether it's the Architects, mother, or Silvermane Guards, there's always an... unnatural element to their actions.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Since encountering you, the unexpected seems to have arrived in waves. I never thought I'd enter the Underworld that has been sealed away for so long...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: I have a feeling that with you, I can pick up the lost threads... and dispel my uncertainties.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Mm, we should be going to see Wildfire. Let's move.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: How are you finding your first Trailblazing expedition?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Pretty great, I enjoy a good adventure!
I feel a bit discombobulated.
Trailblazing expedition? Pretty unremarkable.
...That's good.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: All journeys contain their share of the unexpected. It won't be the last time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Sounds like you've taken it in your stride.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm about to summarize the intel we've gathered so far. Did you want to listen?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's why I'm here.
Uhh, maybe next time.
No problem, come find me any time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: First we have the Underworld — a huge underground space. Miners have built towns here and are excavating Geomarrow.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What's the relation between here and the Overworld?
Do soldiers from the Overworld ever come down here?
I'm clear on this bit. What else?

We learned from Natasha that the Underworld shoulders the energy needs of their entire civilization. Laboring in the Underworld used to be a great honor, and there was regular movement between realms.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Sampo mentioned the Furnace Core, which people would use to travel in both directions. Yet now, each realm is sealed off from the other. Only the automatic transport line for Geomarrow and goods is still in operation.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The reason for sealing the Furnace Core still needs to be investigated. In addition, it appears that Sampo has secret connections that grant him passage between here and the surface. That may come in useful to us.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Up to now, apart from Bronya, whom Sampo brought here, I still haven't seen a single Silvermane Guard.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: At the Fight Club I heard people say that the Guards withdrew from the underground many years ago, and that it was the supreme guardian who gave the order.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: At the time, the supreme guardian was none other than Cocolia Rand.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Next we have our goal — the Stellaron.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: After we revealed our intentions, the supreme guardian suspended communications and sent soldiers to arrest us. Her reaction was strange, to say the least.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Why did the supreme guardian choose to act that way?
Will we find any Stellaron clues in the Underworld?
I'm clear on this bit. What else?
It's too early to say, but it was a radical move. It means that we must have broached a highly sensitive subject... a secret that she's sparing no effort to protect.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If I remember our discussion correctly, I think there are two main possibilities: The Architects, and the Stellaron. I'm inclined to think it's the latter, but we lack evidence.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There's an old saying that goes: "Good fortune lies within bad, bad fortune lurks within good." Even when compared with the Overworld, the Underworld has a long history. There should be valuable intel here. Not to mention, without the supreme guardian's interference, we have a better chance than ever of locating the Stellaron.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Lastly, we have the main strength of the Underworld — Wildfire.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: After the Silvermane Guards withdrew, and in order to keep the peace, the residents of the Underworld spontaneously organized their own militia — thereby taking over the Guards' duties.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Do we need to ally with Wildfire?
Do you trust Wildfire?
Well, I'm all up to speed now.
Ally? It's a little premature to be talking about that.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But Wildfire will be familiar with all manner of forces below ground. If we want to find Stellaron clues in the underground, I'm certain they can help.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I don't know them. Trust isn't part of the picture yet. But speaking of trust, I suggest you don't place too much of yours in Sampo Koski.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: He hasn't revealed his true intentions, but he has managed to corral us into a difficult situation — almost without us realizing. That's a dangerous person indeed.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Mm, that's all we need to summarize for now. If there's anything else you're not clear on, come and find me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is that... Bronya?
She's here too?
Sampo's right, we can't just stand here.
Dan Heng's right, we can't ignore this.
March is right. Does anyone have popcorn?
I'm [Trailblazer].
I'm a friend of Sampo's.
I'm Oleg's guest.
Huh? Isn't that the doctor lady?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What's Natasha doing here...? Things must be worse than I thought.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: That person up ahead... is he asleep?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's head up and take a look, he might need help.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The giant ore vein — the one they discovered... That must be where the clashes are centered?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Come on, let's get to higher ground and take a look.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Robots aligned against humans? I've never heard of such a thing. Machines should obey humans unconditionally...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: That's not the only thing you won't have heard of down here, princess.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Is this the right way? It looks like there's a roadblock up ahead.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: ...I'll be the judge of that. Come on, let's take a closer look.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: These people...
What are you doing here?
I'm not feeling too good...
That's the price of guarding a secret.
The vein should belong to those who discovered it.
We came here willing to help out.
Sounds like a fair trade off.
Not interested, sorry.
Let's save them!
Stay calm...
Leave it to me.
This guy looks stronger than the other robots...
His robots don't seem too friendly...
That girl in red...
Why did Svarog leave?
Are you the chief? You're a hard man to find.
Pleased to meet you. We're here to make friends with Wildfire.
...Do you mean Cocolia?
...Do you mean Sampo?
Is he really that old? He looks pretty new.
You mean the war with the Antimatter Legion?
Nat! I didn't think you'd be here. Where's Oleg?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Hey Seele, and... Sampo's guests. So, it looks like you've already met.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: I haven't seen Oleg. The miners said they saw him take a group further in.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Miners and their family members. They want an explanation from the instigators.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: This area up ahead is a vagrant dwelling, but they've sealed off the entrance. I guess they're afraid that angry miners might try to take revenge.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: *sigh* I heard that many were injured in the clashes, so I hurried over here to see if I could help.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: I heard that the miners had been having violent clashes with local thugs, with significant numbers of wounded. I hurried over to see if I could help.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: You see these people? They're all miners and their family members. They want an explanation from the instigators.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: This area up ahead is a vagrant dwelling, but they've sealed off the entrance. I guess they're afraid that angry miners might try to take revenge.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Oh? You look fine to me. Sorry, I need to prioritize the wounded. There have been violent clashes between the miners and local thugs in the last few days — many people are injured.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: You see these people? They're all miners and their family members. They want an explanation from the instigators.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: This area up ahead is a vagrant dwelling, but they've sealed off the entrance. I guess they're afraid that angry miners might try to take revenge.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: How could the situation here become such a mess?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I heard that First Mining Team found a Geomarrow vein with incredible deposits... The initial estimate put it at the largest discovery in the last thirty years.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Are you serious? That's big news. How come I never heard about it?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Well, they weren't in a hurry to make it known. Most of the mines have been contaminated by the Fragmentum — many people are out of work. They were afraid of being overwhelmed if they let the word out.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: But the vagrants here have keen eyes — they couldn't keep it hidden from them. Some local gangs wanted to profit from the situation, so they blackmailed the mining team for hush money... and that was the final straw.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: *sigh* ...I can understand your thinking. It's just that the underground is in difficult straits...
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: As it happens, that's exactly the law we have down here. But the vagrants have their own custom: See it, share it.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: And that's how the clash started. Now both sides are dealing with heavy losses.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: So, are you guys here to help resolve the conflict?
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: They're here because they need a favor from Chief Oleg. I'm escorting them.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: And seeing as you need that helping hand, it wouldn't be too much to ask you to lend one here first, right?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Of course we wanna help... we care about other people too y'know.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh... that's quite nice of you.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Hmph, of course it is. Nobody gives without expecting something in return.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Suit yourself. I'm not forcing you.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Haha, I believe we're dealing with kind-hearted people here, Seele.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: As you've all seen, the situation down here is... strained. If you can, we really would appreciate you helping the people.
rows.speaker: Natasha

rows.text: Falling asleep in a place like this... impressive!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hey, wakey-wakey! You'll get mushrooms growing on your head~
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hm...? Wha...? Mushroom bread...? I can't see it on the menu... Miss Seele?
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: Have you got a death wish or something? How can you sleep here? Get back to safety and take shelter!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Take shelter... *gasp* I remember now! These guys came out of nowhere and got into a fight with the mining team...
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: At the time I was exhausted — I'd hardly run a few feet when one of them caught me. If it weren't for Wildfire, they'd have stolen the clothes off my back!
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: And then? Where did Wildfire go?
...They'd take your clothes? These ones?
Further in, I guess. Those thugs took control of the vein ages ago — and they're fully armed. We poor, defenseless, good folks were no match for them.
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: It's only thanks to Wildfire that the Great Mine hasn't fallen into their hands completely.
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: You don't know these guys — no moral compass — they'd rob you blind in a flash! It's only thanks to Wildfire that the Great Mine hasn't fallen under their control completely.
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: Uh... speaking of which... where is Wildfire? Did they head further in? Is there a fight happening?
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: ...It seems like Chief Oleg must be up ahead. Hurry up and get back to safety — look for Nat. And try not to get into another scrap along the way.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Okay! Thank you for, um... getting me on my feet! If I get back soon enough, I'll have time for a nap...
rows.speaker: Peak

rows.text: Elaine! Are you okay? Are you hurt?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Seele! Thank goodness. I—I'm fine, just a couple of sprains.
rows.speaker: Elaine

rows.text: You've got good timing — those vagrants were asking me about the robots, but I don't know anything...
rows.speaker: Elaine

rows.text: Robots?
Doesn't ring a bell...
Oh! Don't you know? The inner section of the Great Mine has been seized by a band of robots! Neither the mining team nor the vagrants can get anywhere near.
rows.speaker: Elaine

rows.text: New challengers enter! About time, human-only conflicts are so boring.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Does anyone know where the robots come from?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: At first, we thought that a collective fault had occurred in the excavation machines, but then we found out that those machines didn't even belong to the mining team.
rows.speaker: Elaine

rows.text: They came out of nowhere and pushed the vagrants and us back. Then they blocked off the only tunnels into the inner section.
rows.speaker: Elaine

rows.text: Maybe someone's playing tricks?
Hehe, there's no way anyone in the mining team is behind this... Operating a single unit is tiring enough, but a whole group? Hehe, Impossible.
rows.speaker: Elaine

rows.text: Then there's only one possibility... Boss Svarog.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Svarog? That name sounds familiar...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You remember the robots we defeated in the boxing gym?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Oh! Boss Svarog's robots! What's his deal?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Let's just say he's not to be trifled with. Let's go and find some other people. Elaine, can you make it back to safety?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: No problem. Seele, and the rest of you — be careful...
rows.speaker: Elaine

rows.text: Is this elevator b—broken? Why isn't it r—responding?
rows.speaker: Dense Vagrant

rows.text: Why are you worried about this piece of junk? Do you really wanna go down there and be a live target for the robots?
rows.speaker: Restless Vagrant

rows.text: But, i—if we evacuate, then haven't we lost out?
rows.speaker: Dense Vagrant

rows.text: You idiot — we'll just steal off the miners! Look, I saw with my own eyes — they managed to bag some Geomarrow. This is a perfect opportunity.
rows.speaker: Restless Vagrant

rows.text: Oh, g—good idea!
rows.speaker: Dense Vagrant

rows.text: Shameless. Still after the miners, are you? Time to teach you a lesson.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: ...Cowards and bullies. I don't remember you guys acting this tough around Svarog's minions. Did your parents never teach you what a backbone was?
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: Pff! We ain't stupid! Why would we risk our lives against the robots? And get off the high road — you can't just find a huge chunk of Geomarrow and hog it all to yourselves!
rows.speaker: Vagrant

rows.text: This mine is our territory — the mining team is laboring here day in and day out. You guys don't even pretend like you're here to lend a hand!
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: You're lazy. All you want is to profit off of our sweat and tears. And you don't even try hiding it! ...Disgraceful.
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: Where does disgrace come into it when we can't even fill our stomachs, huh!? I know your game — you're just waiting for us to starve to death, so there's more food for your mining team.
rows.speaker: Vagrant

rows.text: ...It's a waste of time trying to reason with you. While you've been kicking up this fuss, the whole vein's been seized by robots. Now we're all in the same boat.
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: Hehe, right, right... we can't rely on the vein anymore... But don't forget which side brought loaded guns to the party.
rows.speaker: Vagrant

rows.text: Whoa, easy, wh—what are you trying to pull off? I—I'm warning you, Wildfire are in the area...
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: Haha, empty threat! Wildfire are stuck dealing with Svarog's minions — how are they gonna help you now? Unless you're planning on taking a bullet, hand over the supplies and equipment!
rows.speaker: Vagrant

rows.text: They're getting ready to attack! Those miners are unarmed.
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: You shameless scoundrels...
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: You stay calm if you want. I'm taking action! I know those people!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: No need to play the hero, I'm going with you!
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: I'm going too. We can't let these thugs get away with whatever they like!
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Your run-of-the-mill robots don't have a will of their own. Their aim is merely Svarog's aim.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The boss... He appeared suddenly after the Guards were redeployed, and became a major player in the Underworld.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Svarog claims to be a guardian of humanity — all the ownerless robots obey his commands. They've occupied the furnace core hub, and they're not letting anyone get close.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Nobody knows why Svarog did any of this... He usually doesn't leave the Furnace Core and interfere unless some kind of disorder breaks out in the Underworld.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: ...A "guardian of humanity" that can... command robots? I've never heard of anything like...
rows.speaker: Bronya

rows.text: Hmph, looks like your mighty Architects weren't as all-knowing as you thought.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Can you two say anything without quarreling? This isn't the time! It sounds like there's danger waiting for us in the inner section, can we still get through?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I want to meet Svarog and his minions.
We saved the miners, let's go back.
We haven't found Wildfire yet.
Right, there's unfinished business here — the chief is still down there. It's only a bunch of scrap metal. What are we afraid of?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Ohh~ Is Seele starting to appreciate our strength? Hmm?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'll be honest, you guys are hardworking. If everyone from Wildfire were as impressive as you on the battlefield, we wouldn't be so hard-pressed by Svarog.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Antonia, can you take the mining team back through the entrance to meet up with Natasha?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Sure thing, but be careful! There are a lot of robots up ahead!
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: Easy for you to say. This isn't over — the chief and the others are still down there. It's only a bunch of scrap metal. What are we afraid of?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Yeah, you still need to talk with the chief. It's only a bunch of scrap metal. What are we afraid of?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Seele! Thank goodness you came. We were nearly...
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: Nothing but a few knuckleheads. I'm just glad you're okay. Antonia, have you seen Chief Oleg?
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: Oleg? He took a group into the inner section. Said it was to clear off the invading robots.
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: They've been gone for a while now. Hmph, if Wildfire was around, those thugs wouldn't have dared.
rows.speaker: Antonia

rows.text: Seems like the core of this problem is Svarog's robots...
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: What do those robots want?
We need to talk about this "boss..."
You all fix the mine cart together...
Alright, mission accomplished!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmph, quick work. Y'know, I didn't think you guys had worked a day in your lives, but you know how to get your hands dirty.
rows.speaker: Seele

rows.text: The cart is about to depart!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This vein... So this is what everyone is fighting over...
rows.speaker: Clara

rows.text: Mr. Svarog, it's such a massive vein. I've never seen so much Geomarrow before...
rows.speaker: Clara

rows.text: Calculating... Based on the average rate of excavation, this vein is enough to supply Belobog with 231 days of energy, with a margin of error of 7 days.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: I sense that your reason for summoning me is not the ore in question. State your true intention, Clara.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: ...Right. I wanted Mr. Svarog to see that many miners and vagrants have gotten hurt because of the vein... Can you help them?
rows.speaker: Clara

rows.text: I have already prevented the dispute and taken temporary control of the excavation zone. Evaluation result: In the event of no further variables, there will be no large-scale armed conflict within the next 30 days.
rows.speaker: Svarog

rows.text: I know why you did it, Mr. Svarog! It's just... I don't think it'll be enough.
rows.speaker: Clara

rows.text: The mining team and Wildfire... they don't understand your actions... If only we could do more for them...
rows.speaker: Clara
